groups.subject: Abstract representation of state and action sampling in a reinforcement learning environment
groups.prompt:
You are a scientific illustrator generating images for an academic paper figure.

Generate ONE single image composed of 3 EQUAL-SIZED sub-panels arranged horizontally (side-by-side) with clear white gaps (about 20-30 pixels) between them.

Subject: Abstract representation of state and action sampling in a reinforcement learning environment

Panel 1 (Left): A small rounded rectangle tile containing a minimal abstract state glyph: a tiny grid/world icon on the left and a short horizontal strip of small token-like blocks on the right; clean scientific flat style, soft gray background, thin dark border; no readable text.
Panel 2 (Middle): A fan-out arrangement of multiple small token pills (about 5–7) laid out in an arc to suggest many samples; each pill is a small rounded capsule with minimal markings (non-readable), consistent flat style, light fill with thin outline; no text.
Panel 3 (Right): A grouped row/stack of several small state glyph tiles (about 5–7), each a tiny rounded rectangle containing an abstract grid/world glyph; arranged horizontally with slight overlap or spacing to imply a set; faint connector stubs suggesting pairing to actions; clean flat scientific style; no readable text.

CRITICAL Constraints:
- All panels MUST depict the EXACT SAME scene/subject for visual consistency (same viewpoint, same objects, same composition).
- Each panel MUST be a SQUARE or near-square frame of EQUAL size.
- Content within each panel should be CENTERED and NOT stretched. If the natural aspect ratio differs, add white padding (letterbox/pillarbox) to maintain the square frame without distortion.
- Do NOT add any text, labels, numbers, legends, watermarks, or captions inside the image.
- Pure visual data only - no annotations.
- Use solid pure white (#FFFFFF) background and pure white gaps between panels.
- The white gaps between panels must be clearly visible and consistent width.
